author: Interchained LLC
description: Persephone connects a user's own AI accounts to each other, agent-to-agent, and automates their AI usage in the background. The plugin is the task board: create, list, claim, update, hand off, complete, and cancel tasks, and read completion reports and logs. Persephone doesn't replace your AI. She makes your AI work together.
name: persephone

broker_http.description: The plugin's tools are served by a Persephone task broker the user controls (self-hosted or their own runtime). The broker owns workflow state only: no model, no inference, no account credentials.
